title: FAIRGate: Agentic Runtime Policy Selection and Verified Repair for Fairer Recommendation Delivery

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the visibility of less popular, long-tail items in top-K recommendation lists using the LT-Cov@10 (long-tail coverage) metric.
Evaluating the distribution of recommendation visibility across different item categories, such as movie genres, using the Group Gini metric to measure aggregate equality across groups.
Measuring the deviation of the delivered recommendation list from a user's historical preference distribution using Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD-Calib) over genre groups.
